item.title_tr: BETTDOW IPX5 Waterproof Noise Cancelling Bluetooth 5.3 Headphones with Built-in Mic
item.description_tr:
Welcome to the official Bettdow store! Our goal is to offer customers a variety of products that meet their needs for quality and efficiency. Follow us to receive free coupons!

All items are inspected before shipping to ensure they are in perfect condition. Buy our products with ease on Shopee, as we guarantee 100% authenticity.

GUARANTEE Pre- and post-sales services

By your side, ALWAYS assisting you and informing you of what YOU need.

Bluetooth version: V5.3

Battery capacity: 45mAh

Charging compartment capacity: 200mAh with battery protection board.

Range: 10 meters

Charging time: 1 hour

Waiting time: 60 hours

RESOURCES

1. Answer/return calls with one click.

2. Play/pause music: freely control the sound from your phone.

3. Bilateral calls, automatic pairing

4. F13 stereo speaker, clearer sound.

5. TYPE-C charging port, supports the installation of a side cable to prevent loss.

6. Products with Bettdow's exclusive patented design.

7. Long battery life: 200mAh with protection board, longer battery life, talk time up to 8 hours.
